resources.string: Photograph your own wall, mark its holds and set climbs on it.
Walls stay on this phone unless you make them public.

A spray wall is your own wall: you photograph it, mark its holds and set climbs on them. Every change of the holds and every reset with a new photo is kept as a version.

Private or public
A wall stays on this phone unless you make it public. Then its photos, holds and climbs are published over Nostr with your CruxCoach account, and others can add it and set climbs on it. Your logbook is never published.

Backups
Spray walls are not included in Android backups.
Photo of the wall with its holds
Straight on, the whole wall in the picture, even light.
This photo could not be read. Try another one.
This removes the photo, all holds, climbs and their logbook entries from this phone. It can\'t be undone.
The wall is also withdrawn from Nostr and its photos are deleted from the Blossom servers; copies others already have can stay.

Tap a hold to pick it, drag it to move it and use the slider to size it. Press and hold the wall to add a hold, or switch on Add to place several in a row. Pinch to zoom. Orange outlines are suggestions: tap one to take it, or take all. More sensitive shows more, including doubtful ones.
Tap a hold to change its size or remove it.
A wall can have at most %1$d holds.
The holds could not be saved.

Mark the wall\'s holds first, then set climbs on them.
No climbs on this wall yet.
No climbs on the new photo yet. Older ones are under “Earlier”.
Pick a role, then tap holds. Tap a hold again to take it off the climb.
Without a grade the climb is listed as a project.
At most two start and two finish holds.

Mark one or two start holds.

This wall or climb no longer exists.
The photo stays on this phone, saved without the place and other camera data.
The photo is saved without the place and other camera data.
Drag the corners or edges to crop to the wall. Turn the photo until the wall stands upright.
Take a new photo of “%1$s”. The climbs set so far stay with the old photo under “Earlier”.
The holds of the new photo start fresh. The old photo, its holds and its climbs stay as a version: Versions can bring that state back at any time.
The new photo has no holds yet. Mark them now, or discard the reset to go back to the wall as it was.
No open suggestions. More sensitive shows less sure ones.
No holds found. Mark them by hand: press and hold the wall, or switch on Add.
Download the hold model once (33 MB). It finds holds of every colour with their real shape and then runs on this phone without internet. You can remove it again in Settings under Delete local data.
The download did not work. Check the connection and try again.
For finding holds on spray walls. Without it a simpler search suggests holds; you can download it again at any time.
Looking for holds did not work on this photo. Mark them by hand.
The hold model could not run on this photo. These suggestions come from the simpler detector.
Holds saved as a new version. Climbs that use a removed hold keep it, drawn dashed.
Every saved change of the holds, every reset with a new photo and every restore is kept as a version. Tap a version to see it; restoring it makes it current again without deleting anything.
Its photo and holds become the wall\'s current state again, as a new version. Nothing is deleted: the versions in between stay in the list.
Set before the wall was reset. It is shown on the photo it was set on.
Published with your CruxCoach account. Your logbook stays private.

Private
The wall stays on this phone. Nothing about it is published.

Public
The photo of every version, the holds and the climbs are published over Nostr with your CruxCoach account. Others can add the wall and set climbs on it. You can withdraw it later, but copies others already have can stay. Your logbook stays private.

The photo of every version of this wall, its holds and the climbs on it become public under your CruxCoach account. You can withdraw the wall later, but copies others already have can stay. Your logbook is never published.
The photos must not show people.
Publishing a wall needs a CruxCoach account.
Upload failed: no connection. The wall is saved on this phone.
The wall, its versions, your climbs on it and its photos are deleted from the servers. Others may keep copies they already have. The wall stays on this phone as a private wall.
The servers did not confirm the withdrawal, so the wall is still public. Check the connection and try again.

The relays took the withdrawal, but a photo could not be deleted from its Blossom server, so the withdrawal is not finished. Until it is, nothing of this wall is published. Check the connection and try again.
Signing did not work or was declined in your signer app, so the wall is still public. Try again and confirm the requests.
Withdrawing needs the CruxCoach account key the wall was published with. Set it up in Settings under CruxCoach Account, then try again.
A public wall is deleted here only once it is withdrawn.
Withdrawing did not finish. Until it does, nothing of this wall is published.
Signing did not work or was declined in your signer app. The relays already took part of the withdrawal, so nothing of this wall is published until it is finished. Try again and confirm the requests.
The withdrawal did not finish. The relays already took part of it, so nothing of this wall is published until it is finished. Check the connection and try again.
